# XY Forever serial protocol 1.33: staging commands

Part of the [XY Forever serial protocol 1.33](../PROTOCOL.md).

### 0x10 `stage.begin`

Announce an image to stage in RAM. Starts a new staging and forgets any earlier one, also when it is refused (a `stage.data` after a refused `stage.begin` is
`state`). Staging holds one image in processor B's RAM for `file.write_staged`, `boot.install` or `boot.uninstall`; it does not survive a restart. A size of 0
is also `too_large`.

| Request field (40 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | u32 | image bytes, at most `max_stage` (1..7340032) |
| `crc32` | u32 | CRC-32 of the whole image |
| `sha256` | bytes[32] | SHA-256 of the whole image |

Reply: the status only.

Errors: `bad_request`, `too_large`. Tool timeout: 5 s. Since 1.0.

### 0x11 `stage.data`

Send the next piece of the staged image. In order, without gaps: `range` when `offset` is not the bytes received so far or the data would pass the announced
size; a resend of bytes already received, unchanged (a retry after a lost reply), is ok and `received` stays. `state` without a `stage.begin`, and also for a
request without data.

| Request field (5 to 4160 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `offset` | u32 | must equal the bytes received so far |
| `data` | rest, 1..4156 B | the next bytes; send `put_chunk` (1024) at a time |

| Reply field, after the status (4 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `received` | u32 | bytes received so far |

On an error: the status only. Errors: `state`, `range`. Tool timeout: 5 s. Since 1.0.

### 0x12 `stage.end`

Check the staged image against its CRC-32 and SHA-256. `state` when not every announced byte arrived. After any error the staging is discarded; start again with
`stage.begin`. A repeated `stage.end` after an ok one (a retry after a lost reply) is ok again and keeps the staging, until `boot.install`, `boot.uninstall` or
`file.copy` uses it up or a `stage.begin` replaces it.

Request: empty (the device ignores any payload).

Reply: the status only.

Errors: `state`, `crc`, `sha`. Tool timeout: 10 s. Since 1.0.

### 0x13 `file.write_staged`

Write the staged image to a file under /yaffs2/ (the write area). Creates or replaces the file, reads it back and compares its CRC-32 (`crc` on a difference). A
path the device's write check rejects is `refused` (1.0: `bad_request`): since 1.13 the write area is all of `/yaffs2/` except the dev-menu marker
`/yaffs2/bootloader.dev` and the stock updater's inbox `/yaffs2/upgrade` (and anything inside it), both any ASCII case and also when reached through a link;
also a path with an empty, `.` or `..` part, or a control byte. Before 1.13 the area was `/yaffs2/xy-forever/` and (1.7) `/yaffs2/content/`, no name holding
`bootloader`; a request whose length does not match its path is `bad_request`. Needs a complete staging (`state` otherwise). The host tool restarts the device
(`device.reboot`) and stages again before each write, the tested path; a second write in the same boot is untested. The host waits 60 s plus 1 s per 20000
bytes. To be replaced by streaming file commands.

| Request field (42 to 272 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | cstr UTF-8, 10..240 B | `/yaffs2/` and at least one more character, NUL-terminated; no empty, `.` or `..` parts; no control bytes; never `/yaffs2/bootloader.dev`, never inside `/yaffs2/upgrade/` (1.13); at most 6 folders below `/yaffs2` (1.16); missing folders are created |
| `sha256` | bytes[32] | confirmation: the staged image's SHA-256 again |

| Reply field, after the status (8 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `written` | u32 | bytes written |
| `readback_crc` | u32 | CRC-32 of the file read back |

On an error: every field (zero where not reached). Errors: `bad_request`, `refused`, `state`, `sha`, `link`, `storage`, `not_found`, `crc`. Tool timeout: 60 s.
**Destructive**: ask the user first. Build switch `XYF_USB_FILE_WRITE`, not optional: the firmware does not build without it. Since 1.1.
